text:
mira: Quick heads-up — PR #452 (docs) landed a migration guide for Optimize but I spotted a few broken links and an outdated quant profile example that breaks the SDK snippet tests. :eyes:

mira: Specifically: the page references /optkit/quant-profiles which 404s, and the Python example still uses the old QuantProfile constructor.

mira: Example from the PR that fails CI:
```python
from redwood.optimize import QuantProfile
q = QuantProfile(precision='int8', calibrate=True)
```

tim: I'll take the link fixes. Which files?

mira: docs/batching.md (links to the prefetchexamples) and docs/quant-profiles.md (the quant snippet). Also the migration checklist page needs a note about SDK v0.9 changes.

kevin: The QuantProfile ctor changed — use dtype and a calibrator object now. Minimal working example we use in infra tests:
```python
from redwood.optimize import QuantProfile, DefaultCalibrator
q = QuantProfile(dtype='qint8', calibrator=DefaultCalibrator())
```
kevin: Also drop calibrate=True; that flag was removed in 0.9.

jen: Is this blocking the docs release tomorrow? I can push the schedule if it's just a quick fix.

docs-bot: PR #452 — snippet-exec: failed (1), link-checker: 3 broken links. See CI artifact: https://ci.redwood.example/452/artifacts

tim: I'll open a tiny PR that rewrites the broken /optkit path to /optimize/quantization and swaps the example. Won't touch wording beyond that.

kevin: I'll add a short snippet test under docs/tests/snippets/quant_profile_smoke.py that runs snippet-exec in CI. Should catch regressions.

mira: Perfect. Also add an entry in the migration checklist: "If updating from SDK <0.9, replace QuantProfile(precision=...) with QuantProfile(dtype=...) and switch to calibrator API".

jen: OK — if Tim has the link/snip PR by EOD and Kevin adds the test, we can re-run CI and merge. I'll hold the release if CI still fails.

tim: pinging @kevin when I open the PR so you can add the test quickly.

kevin: ack — will draft the test and a tiny fixture.

mira: One more small ask: double-check any docs that show batching examples with continuous KV caching — some of the sample code used the old runtime flag `kv_cache_enabled=True` which is now `kv_prefetch='auto'`. If we miss those, snippet-exec might not fail but it misleads users.

tim: Got it — I'll grep for `kv_cache_enabled` and replace with the new config.

docs-bot: CI re-run queued by tim — https://ci.redwood.example/452/rerun/1

jen: Thanks all. If anything blocks, drop a note in #release-war-room. :thumbsup:

mira: Assigning tasks in the PR description so reviewers can triage quickly. Thanks! :shipit:
